issues.title: RTL punctuation and truncation artifacts
issues.description: English transcript text exhibits RTL punctuation flipping and broken leading ellipsis under right-to-left layout.
issues.evidence: Widget displays '..n the eu-central-1' and wrapped '.dropped' with leading period.
issues.suggestion: Set dir='ltr' or unicode-bidi isolation on transcript text containers.
issues.triageNote:
Real bidi defect: excerpt

and error had no directional isolation, so English prose on RTL pages got punctuation flipped and the line-clamp ellipsis rendered at the leading edge; fixed with dir="auto" on both text slots (Arabic content still resolves RTL).

issues.title: Playback duration anomaly
issues.description: The progress timestamp displays an elapsed time greater than total duration.
issues.evidence: Timestamp reads '18:40 / 03:12 LIVE' in the player header.
issues.suggestion: Adjust playback timer values to reflect valid elapsed and total duration.
issues.triageNote: Not a data anomaly — the position string 03:12 / 18:40 is a weak-direction numeric run: in an RTL paragraph the bidi algorithm reorders it to read 18:40 / 03:12; fixed with dir="ltr" isolation on the position span (plus ml-auto→ms-auto on the header close button so it pins to the inline-end in RTL).

issues.title: Inverted playback skip controls (found in post-fix re-audit of pair-168)
issues.description: Under RTL the flex row mirrored the transport, so skip-forward sat left of play and skip-backward right of play.
issues.evidence: Re-audit pair-168: 'The skip forward icon appears on the left of play, while skip backward appears on the right.'
issues.triageNote: Real RTL mirroring defect surfaced by the post-fix vision re-audit; the three rings are now wrapped in a dir="ltr" cluster so the transport keeps standard media order (prev · play · next) matching the LTR timecode, while the explain pill stays at the row's inline-end. LTR pages are visually unchanged.
